requirement.clarified: Remove the hardcoded WEB_TABLET_MAX_WIDTH_CAP=800 constant in useHeaderMaxWidth.ts so the top-bar's content max-width is driven entirely by the reactive formula `windowWidth - leftDrawerWidth - rightSidebarWidth`. Restores correct expand/contract direction on sidebar toggles and aligns avatar with viewport right edge on desktop.
requirement.what: Remove the 800px artificial cap inside the existing useHeaderMaxWidth hook so the already-reactive formula's true output drives layout (instead of being clamped to 800).
requirement.why: Cycle 1 made the calculation reactive but preserved the legacy 800 cap, so on 1920 viewport the avatar still sits 394px short of the right edge and any sidebar toggle is masked by the cap (both states clamp to 800). User reports this as both §5.4 (non-adaptive) and §5.5 (inverted-toggle clustering).

root_cause_analysis.symptom: At 1920 viewport, top-bar's avatar sits at right=1526 (394px short of viewport right edge); logo appears pinned at the left at ~17px; toggling the right sidebar moves elements but does NOT expand the header content area into the freed space — instead user perceives elements clustering toward the centered 800px box.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: useHeaderMaxWidth.ts:42 applies `Math.min(available, WEB_TABLET_MAX_WIDTH_CAP)` where WEB_TABLET_MAX_WIDTH_CAP=800 (line 15). On any web/tablet viewport ≥ ~880px (drawer + 800), `available` exceeds 800 so the cap dominates the formula's true output. Both sidebar-open and sidebar-closed states produce maxWidth=800 (the cap), so toggling visually shifts the centered 800px container's position rather than its width — appearing to the user as 'clustering' rather than 'expanding'.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: 0ba2ddfc - feat: cycle 1 (14 pipelines) + close-remediation (introduced useHeaderMaxWidth hook AND preserved the 800 cap from the legacy static layout.headerMaxWidth)
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Cycle 1 BA spec ba-spec-20260424-143000-11.md R4 explicitly sanctioned 'if those caps are still desired' — the 800 cap was carried over from the original static `layout.headerMaxWidth` constant without re-evaluation against user feedback. The hook fixed the static-vs-reactive issue but left the value untouched.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: User's complaint is precisely about the cap value, not the calculation method. Making the calculation reactive is necessary but not sufficient — the cap itself must be removed for the header content area to actually consume the available space. Until the cap is removed, no toggle can be expressed visually because the 800 floor masks all variations beyond drawer width on wide viewports.

attempts.proposed_solution: Replace static layout.headerMaxWidth=800 constant with a hook (useHeaderMaxWidth) that re-evaluates on every render using windowWidth, left-drawer state, and right-sidebar open/close.
attempts.actual_change: Created packages/happy-app/sources/hooks/useHeaderMaxWidth.ts (new file). Refactored Header.tsx and ChatHeaderView.tsx to consume the hook. Critically retained the 800 cap as WEB_TABLET_MAX_WIDTH_CAP and applied via Math.min(available, 800) on the non-Mac branch.
attempts.outcome: PARTIAL FIX. The hook IS reactive (re-renders on viewport/sidebar change), but the preserved 800 cap dominates on viewports ≥ ~880 so the header still measures 800 regardless of viewport size or sidebar state. Cycle 5 QA confirmed avatar.right=1526 at 1920 → R_delta=394 still exceeds the user's expectation; user explicitly reported §5.5 inverted-toggle symptom is the same root cause.

novelty_check.rationale: Cycle 1 (prior attempt) restructured the *computation* (static const → reactive hook) but kept the *value* of the artificial 800 cap. This attempt does NOT touch the computation structure at all — it deletes the 800 cap (the magic-number clamp at the function tail) so the existing reactive formula's true output drives layout. The action axis is different: prior = restructure-formula; this = remove-clamp. Different code site within the same file, different operation kind. Acceptable per Contract D — 'a different (typically deeper) layer' is also satisfied here in the sense that we are now removing the *root assumption* (that 800 is a desirable cap) rather than restructuring around it.
